title: Show/Hide-chart control sits on the report filter row
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with the Reports permission on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. Open one of the four reports that carries the embedded chart (Sales, Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, or Technician Utilization).
custom_steps:
1. Look at the row that holds the report’s filters and its ⋯ (more actions) menu.
2. Find the "Show chart" / "Hide chart" control and note where it sits relative to the filters and the ⋯ menu.
3. Check the spacing between the control, the filters and the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The "Show chart" / "Hide chart" control sits on the same horizontal line as the report’s filters and its ⋯ (more actions) menu, immediately to the right of them.
  • The gap between each of those controls is the same.
  • The control never sits on a row of its own above the chart.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9583 (S11 — Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S11; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R2a: “The control sits on the same horizontal line as the report’s filters and its ⋯ (more actions) menu, immediately to the right of them, and the gap between each of those controls is the same. It never sits on a row of its own above the chart.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
